title: BSUSC Bihar Assistant Professor Interview Latter 2026
postName: Assistant Professor – Various Subjects (University / College level)
vacancyDetails: Interview call letter for Bihar BSUSC Assistant Professor recruitment 2026
qualification: Master’s degree with NET/SET/Ph.D. or as per UGC & BSUSC Assistant Professor rules
documentsRequired: Interview letter printout; educational certificates, NET/Ph.D., category certificate, photo ID, experience proofs
howToApply:
1. Visit official BSUSC portal
2. Open Assistant Professor Interview Letter 2026 link
3. Login or download call letter PDF
4. Note interview date, venue and reporting time
5. Appear with original documents and self-attested copies
shortDescription: BSUSC Bihar Assistant Professor Interview Letter 2026 released. Download call letter from official portal.
content:
Bihar State University Service Commission (BSUSC) has released the Assistant Professor Interview Letter 2026 (Interview Latter as listed in public notices).

Shortlisted candidates can download the interview call letter and report on the allotted date with original educational and identity documents for verification.

Interview checklist

  • Printed interview letter
  • Photo ID and photographs
  • Degree, marksheets, NET/Ph.D. certificates
  • Category / domicile certificates if claimed
